Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a competition-based chemoproteomics approach where LH205 (biotinylated probe) is used for enrichment and LH168 (unlabeled compound) is used as a competitor to determine selectivity. This constitutes a factorial design (LH168 +/- and LH205 +/-).

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The project explicitly states that DIA mode was used for measurement and searched in Spectronaut, with precursor-level data exported for protein abundance calculation.
DDA mode was also performed and used to generate a hybrid spectral library.

workflow: Each sample was measured in data-independent acquisition (DIA) and data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
The DIA runs were searched in Biognosys Spectronaut v.19.1 against the generated library
A hybrid spectral library was generated from all DDA and DIA runs
differential: protein abundances were calculated for proteins with at least three observed precursors in each sample
significance was determined using a moderated t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg multiple testing correction
Changes in protein abundances were considered significant, if the absolute fold change (log2) is greater than one unit and the adjusted p values are below 0.05
search_parameters: resuspended in 20 µL of 2% ACN with 0.1% FA and 0.2x iRT standard (Biognosys)
LysC/P was added to the cleavage rules
